self_assessment: Consolidated ListMixin+List into List(Thing) and moved ListChangeset into openlibrary/core/lists/model.py with a register_models() that binds /type/list and the 'lists' changeset; core models.register_models() now delegates to it via a lazy import (a top-level one deadlocks: List's base Thing is defined below the import site), so both startup paths (plugins/openlibrary/code.py and upstream setup()) register it with no extra call, and the 'lists' registration exists only in the lists module. ListChangeset was re-based on client.Changeset to avoid a core->plugins.upstream cycle, so I hand-restored can_undo() (recentchanges/header.html calls it on every changeset view) and re-exported ListChangeset from plugins/upstream/models.py for the pre-existing TYPE_CHECKING import in upstream/utils.py and test_setup; the undo-POST helpers (_undo/get_undo_changeset) were NOT carried over -- can_undo() is False so the UI never offers undo on a list changeset, matching base behaviour, but a hand-crafted POST to /recentchanges/.../lists/<id> would now AttributeError instead of being processed. TestList moved from tests/core/test_models.py to tests/core/test_lists_model.py (the 'test definitions scattered across unrelated test files' the issue names). Full suite is byte-identical to base (1598 passed / 10 skipped / 17 xfailed / 54 xpassed, 0 failed) before and after, plus ruff 0.1.6, black 23.11, mypy 1.7 (one pre-existing types-requests stub error) and scripts/run_doctests.sh (1353 passed) clean. Proved live with a 17-case throwaway suite (deleted before delivery): all 17 flip at base, and four one-line reverts flip disjoint sets -- dropping the delegation flips only the 3 startup-registration cases, dropping the changeset registration flips only the 4 changeset cases, narrowing the get_owner regex flips only the hyphen/underscore owners, and dropping the Thing base flips only the model-behaviour cases.
